name: C2-2 Concentric Circles: where linear classifiers die
description: One straight line, two rings: 27 of 60 test points right

data.noteContent:
Two rings, one inside the other, and a classifier that can only draw a straight line. No line separates them, so LogisticRegression is reduced to guessing: the accuracy Print reads 0.45, which is 27 of the 60 test points -- what a coin would manage.

The two examples beside it answer this failure on the same data and the same wiring. The SVM one swaps in an RBF kernel; the MLP one swaps in two layers with ReLU. Both reach 1.0, so the data was never the problem.

Nothing downloads and the run is instant. Change the classifier node here and watch the same graph succeed.

兩圈點，一圈套在另一圈裡，而分類器只會畫直線。沒有任何直線切得開，所以 LogisticRegression 只能用猜的：準確率的 Print 是 0.45，也就是 60 個測試點裡對了 27 個 -- 跟丟銅板差不多。

旁邊兩個範例用同一份資料、同一組接線回答這個失敗：SVM 那張換上 RBF 核，MLP 那張換上兩層帶 ReLU 的網路，兩者都拿到 1.0，可見問題從來不在資料。

不用下載，執行是瞬間的。把這裡的分類器節點換掉，就能看到同一張圖變成成功。

LogisticRegression fits w . x + b and cuts along one straight boundary. For concentric rings the best straight cut is barely better than no cut, which is why the number below lands near 0.5 rather than near 0: the model is not broken, it is the wrong shape for this data.

LogisticRegression 擬合的是 w . x + b，切出來就是一條直線。對同心圓來說，最好的那條直線也只比不切好一點，所以下面的數字會落在 0.5 附近而不是 0 附近：模型沒有壞，只是形狀不對。
